Title: Migrate Copilot Studio agents to Microsoft Entra Agent ID
Summary: On August 24, 2026, we initiated the gradual roll out of self-service migrations to Microsoft Entra Agent IDs for Copilot Studio agents in Power Platform Advisor. Beginning on September 2026, automatic migrations of agents without Entra Agent ID to Microsoft Entra Agent ID were also initiated. Copilot Studio agents created before May 2026 may still use legacy app-registration identities. We recommend migrating any of your remaining agents to Microsoft Entra Agent ID.
